name: aceternity-ui
description: Aceternity UI — premium copy-paste React & Next.js UI components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion (Framer Motion). Covers backgrounds, cards, text effects, buttons, loaders, navigation, inputs, overlays, carousels, grids, 3D, cursors, plus shadcn-compatible section blocks. Use when the user wants famous animated UI components (spotlight, sparkles, aurora background, 3D card, bento grid, magnetic button, typewriter, moving border, hero parallax, etc.).
